import pyautogui, time

# 1) Right-click on an empty area of the bookmarks bar
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.click(400, 145, button='right')
time.sleep(0.5)

# 2) In the context menu, choose "Add folder…" (second item)
pyautogui.press(['down', 'down', 'enter'])
time.sleep(0.5)

# 3) Type the folder name and confirm
pyautogui.write('Favorites')
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press('enter')
